# Alok Shrestha - Principal Engineer & BI Developer

> Portfolio and Web Applications Portal (aloks.com.np) by Alok Shrestha, based in Kathmandu, Nepal.

## Summary
Alok Shrestha is a Principal Software Engineer and BI Developer with extensive experience in data engineering, Power BI, SQL, Python, ETL automation, and building high-impact data-driven applications.

## Technical Skills & Expertise
- **BI & Data Visualization**: Power BI, DAX, Tableau, Excel
- **Data Engineering & Analytics**: SQL, Python, Pandas, Web Scraping (Puppeteer, BeautifulSoup, Selenium), Azure Data Pipelines
- **Web Applications**: Modern JavaScript, HTML5/CSS3, Civic Web Utilities, API Integrations
- **Domains**: Education, Healthcare, e-Commerce, Government Open Data Integrations

## Featured Applications & Projects
1. **Nepal Smart Driving License Print Checker**:
   - URL: `https://aloks.com.np/license-print-check/`
   - Purpose: Unified real-time print status & collection guidance across 4 Bagamati Province Transport Management Offices (Ekantakuna, Kalanki, Chabahil, Radhe Radhe).
2. **Nepal Income Tax Calculator**:
   - URL: `https://aloks.com.np/nepal-tax-calculator/`
   - Purpose: Real-time tax calculation for single and married individuals under Government of Nepal tax slabs.
